run_flash_fwd: run the flash3 forward pass custom op for multi-head attention on CUDA devices
run_flash_bwd: run the flash3 backward pass custom op for multi-head attention gradient computation
register_flop_formula: register flop counting formulas for flash3 forward and backward custom ops
use_FwOp: use the FwOp class to configure and execute flash3 attention forward operations
use_BwOp: use the BwOp class to configure and execute flash3 attention backward operations
